integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic fashion video, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, one uninterrupted static overhead shot. Begin exactly from <Picture 1>.

IDENTITY LOCK: Preserve the same adult young East Asian woman's facial identity, facial features, long hair, hairstyle, body proportions, limb proportions, skin tone, age and overall appearance shown in <Picture 1> throughout the entire 15-second video. She must never change face, change hairstyle, change hair color, change body shape, change body proportions or be replaced by another person. No additional person, duplicated body, body fusion or extra limb may appear at any moment.

ORIGINAL OUTFIT: Preserve the original blue short-sleeve collared shirt, white high-waisted fitted short skirt, black stockings and black pointed high heels shown in the opening image at the beginning of the video. At 0.00 seconds the video must be exactly identical to <Picture 1>. No target outfit may appear early at any point before its transformation sweep.

ENVIRONMENT LOCK: Preserve the original cream leather chaise lounge with stitched seams, the light grey marble-textured wall, the light grey marble-textured floor, background, lighting, shadows, the foreground ceiling fan and all original spatial relationships. Throughout the entire video the furniture does not move, the background, floor, lighting direction and shadow relationships do not change, the woman's position does not change, and the fan hub position does not change. Apart from the woman's clothing, no object in the environment may deform or be replaced.

CAMERA LOCK: the camera remains absolutely fixed throughout the entire 15-second video. Maintain exactly the same viewpoint, camera height, focal length, framing, perspective, exposure and orientation as <Picture 1>. No cut, zoom, push-in, pull-out, pan, tilt, tracking, orbit, camera roll, shake, reframing or composition drift.

BODY LOCK: the woman remains lying in exactly the same position and orientation as in <Picture 1>, with the same head position, shoulders, torso, arms, hands, hips, legs and feet placement. The pose is locked, yet she must be visibly alive and natural at all times: natural breathing with a subtle, continuous rise and fall of the chest and abdomen, frequent natural blinking, tiny eye movements, gentle gaze shifts, very slight natural head turning within the same resting head position, very slight natural hair movement, and very slight finger movements. No sitting up, turning over, lifting the head off the surface, large limb movement, pose change or body drift.

FACIAL EXPRESSION & LIVELINESS: the woman must never appear expressionless, frozen, rigid, blank or mannequin-like at any moment. Her face carries a soft, natural, relaxed expression that subtly evolves throughout the entire video: a gentle faint smile that softly breathes and shifts, natural blinking of both eyes at natural intervals, tiny eye movements and gentle gaze shifts (she may look softly toward the camera and occasionally glance slightly to the side), and micro-movements of the eyebrows and lips. All of this is expression and liveliness only: her facial identity, facial features, face shape, hairstyle, skin, body shape and body proportions never change.

FAN MOTION: the foreground ceiling fan remains physically in front of the woman and rotates continuously clockwise as viewed from the camera looking down at the scene. Clockwise means the blade tips keep traveling in the same rotational direction as the blade motion implied by <Picture 1>, and this exact direction must be held for the entire 15 seconds. The fan hub remains fixed in exactly the same upper-left position as in <Picture 1>. Preserve the original blade count, blade length, blade width, dark brown wood material, wood-grain texture, color, thickness and physical depth shown in <Picture 1>. The blades rotate at a slow, steady and constant speed with natural restrained motion blur. Counterclockwise rotation, reverse rotation, direction alternation, oscillation or any reversal of the blade travel direction is strictly forbidden for the entire video. The fan never stops, never reverses, never suddenly speeds up, never suddenly slows down, never shakes, never deforms, never stretches, never shrinks, never gains or loses blades, never disappears and never changes its axis position.

MASTER BLADE: Use the broad dark brown wooden blade crossing the woman's torso in <Picture 1> as the designated master blade. From the first frame until the last frame it must remain exactly the same single physical blade.

MASTER BLADE IDENTITY LOCK: exactly one physical blade is designated as the master blade for the entire video. Its identity must remain continuous and unmistakable throughout all rotations. No other blade may become the master blade, imitate its transformation function or trigger any wardrobe change. All three wardrobe changes must be completed clockwise by this same single master blade and by no other element.

ROTATION DIRECTION LOCK: the fan must rotate clockwise only, as viewed from the camera, for the entire 15 seconds. The rotation direction is fixed at the first frame and may never reverse, alternate, oscillate or flip. The designated master blade must always travel across the woman's body in the same direction as the blade motion implied by <Picture 1>, entering each region from the same side and exiting toward the same side, never backwards and never against the wind. Any appearance of counterclockwise rotation, reverse rotation, direction switching or mid-rotation reversal is strictly forbidden.

TRAILING-EDGE-ONLY TRANSFORMATION RULE: wardrobe transformation is triggered exclusively by the trailing edge of the designated master blade.

The leading edge of the master blade does not transform anything.

The main surface of the master blade does not transform anything merely by covering or occluding the woman.

The other fan blades do not transform anything.

Their leading edges do not transform anything.

Their trailing edges do not transform anything.

Their surfaces do not transform anything.

Their shadows do not transform anything.

Motion blur from any non-master blade does not transform anything.

Only the narrow spatial boundary immediately behind the trailing edge of the same designated master blade is allowed to convert the clothing from the previous state into the next state.

For every point on the woman's body, the transformation must obey this exact sequence:

1. BEFORE the master blade arrives:
the visible region remains completely in the previous outfit.

2. AFTER the leading edge arrives but while the blade is physically covering that region:
the region remains logically in the previous outfit beneath the blade. Occlusion alone does not trigger transformation.

3. ONLY when the trailing edge physically passes beyond that exact region:
the newly revealed region immediately behind the trailing edge appears in the next outfit.

Therefore the transformation boundary must remain physically attached to and directly follow the trailing edge of the master blade.

COMPLETE CONVERSION PER PASS: during each of the three transformation sweeps, every body region crossed by the trailing edge of the master blade must be converted at that exact moment. A valid sweep must never pass over the body without producing the corresponding outfit change, and no region may remain in the old outfit after its trailing-edge passage.

NO PRE-TRANSFORMATION: no body region may change before the trailing edge of the master blade has physically crossed that exact location.

WORKED EXAMPLE (trailing edge just passed the waist): if the trailing edge of the master blade has just swept past the woman's waist, then the head, forehead, face, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, chest and every region already passed may already appear in the new outfit; the narrow band of skin and clothing immediately behind the waist, just revealed by the trailing edge, may begin converting into the new outfit; the thighs, knees, lower legs, ankles, feet and shoes that have not yet been passed by the trailing edge must remain exactly in the previous outfit. The full outfit must never change as one simultaneous whole at any instant.

NO DELAYED TRANSFORMATION / INSTANT REVEAL RULE: once the trailing edge passes a body region, that newly revealed region must already be fully converted into the next outfit at that very moment. The new outfit is worn beneath the blade all along and is merely uncovered by the trailing edge. Conversion must never lag behind the blade, never wait for the next blade pass, never appear gradually across later frames, and never trigger at the wrong time such as when another blade arrives. The state change occurs exactly at the instant of trailing-edge passage, with zero delay.

FULL-BODY COVERAGE RULE: during every valid transformation passage, the designated master blade must physically sweep across and cumulatively cover the woman's complete visible body from the top of her hair to the tips of both shoes, covering hair, forehead, face, neck, shoulders, both arms, both hands, chest, torso, waist, hips, skirt or trousers, thighs, knees, lower legs, hosiery or exposed legs, ankles, feet, and both shoes.

The master blade's valid transformation sweep must begin above the top of the woman's hair and continue progressively across her entire head-to-toe silhouette.

The transformation is not complete until the trailing edge of the master blade has moved completely beyond the tips of both shoes.

PARTIAL-STATE RULE: at any intermediate moment, the woman may temporarily contain both the previous outfit and the next outfit, but only according to the exact physical position of the master blade's trailing edge.

All regions already passed by the trailing edge show the new outfit.

All regions not yet passed by the trailing edge remain in the previous outfit.

There must be one clean moving transformation boundary directly following the trailing edge.

OUTFIT 1:
a fitted red halter-neck dress trimmed with white fluffy fur pom-poms along its hemline, worn with the existing black pointed high heels.

OUTFIT 2:
a soft pink sheer translucent gauze pajama robe, worn barefoot with no shoes.

OUTFIT 3:
a black bikini, consisting of a black bikini top and matching black bikini bottoms, worn barefoot with no shoes.

SHOES RULE: shoes and footwear are part of the wardrobe transformation and obey exactly the same trailing-edge rule. Neither shoe may change until the trailing edge of the designated master blade has physically swept across that exact shoe. When an outfit requires bare feet, the heels are progressively removed and the feet become bare only as the trailing edge sweeps across the corresponding legs, ankles and feet; no shoe or barefoot state may appear early.

TIMELINE:

[0.00s–5.00s] Original Outfit → Outfit 1:
The video begins exactly at <Picture 1> in the original outfit. The fan rotates continuously clockwise from the first frame. When the designated master blade naturally reaches its correct sweep position, its trailing edge begins above the top of the woman's hair and progressively sweeps across her head, forehead, face, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, chest, waist, hips, thighs, knees, lower legs, feet and shoes. Only regions already passed by the trailing edge convert into Outfit 1; all regions not yet passed remain in the original outfit. Outfit 1 becomes fully established only after the trailing edge of the same master blade has completely moved beyond the tips of both shoes, and this first transformation must be completed within the 0.00s–5.00s window by the same continuous clockwise rotation, with no direction reversal. Throughout this phase the woman stays alive: breathing, blinking and subtle expressions continue.

[5.00s–10.00s] Outfit 1 → Outfit 2:
The fan continues its steady clockwise rotation without pause, jump, reset or reversal. The same designated master blade again rotates naturally back above the top of the woman's hair and begins the second complete head-to-toe sweep. Only the trailing edge of the same designated master blade may trigger transformation: regions it has passed convert from Outfit 1 into Outfit 2 at the instant of trailing-edge passage, regions it has not yet passed remain in Outfit 1. Outfit 2 becomes fully established only after the trailing edge has completely moved beyond the tips of both bare feet, and this second transformation must be completed within the 5.00s–10.00s window by the same continuous clockwise rotation, with no direction reversal. Throughout this phase the woman stays alive: breathing, blinking and subtle expressions continue.

[10.00s–15.00s] Outfit 2 → Outfit 3:
The same designated master blade again enters a third natural sweep above the top of the woman's hair and performs the third complete head-to-toe scan. Regions passed by its trailing edge convert from Outfit 2 into Outfit 3 at the instant of trailing-edge passage; regions not yet passed remain in Outfit 2. Outfit 3 becomes fully established only after the trailing edge has completely moved beyond the tips of both bare feet, and this third transformation must be completed within the 10.00s–15.00s window by the same continuous clockwise rotation, with no direction reversal. Throughout this phase the woman stays alive: breathing, blinking and subtle expressions continue. The video ends holding Outfit 3.

NO MULTI-BLADE ASSISTANCE: other blades may naturally pass in front of the woman during rotation, but they are visually inert with respect to wardrobe transformation.

They must never complete missing regions, extend the transformation boundary, initiate a new outfit, repair an incomplete scan or cause secondary transformation patches.

SINGLE TRANSFORMATION FRONT: there must be only one active transformation front at any moment, and this front must coincide exactly with the trailing edge of the designated master blade.

No secondary transformation fronts, disconnected patches, radial waves, glow waves, dissolves or simultaneous full-body changes are allowed.

TRANSFORMATION STYLE: the wardrobe change is clean, realistic and physically hidden by the moving blade. No magical glow, particles, sparks, smoke, energy waves, morphing aura, liquid transition, digital glitch, flash, explosion or supernatural transformation effect.

WARDROBE STABILITY: once a region has transformed into the new outfit, it remains completely stable and does not flicker, revert, morph, recolor or change design.

IDENTITY SEPARATION: the transformation affects clothing, footwear and explicitly requested wearable accessories only. It must never transform the woman's face, skin, hair, body shape, anatomy, age or identity.

OCCLUSION LOCK: preserve the real foreground-background depth relationship from <Picture 1>. The fan blades remain physically closer to the camera than the woman and correctly occlude her whenever they pass over her body. The woman must never appear in front of a fan blade that should physically be closer to the camera.

FINAL STATE: By the end of the video, the same woman remains in exactly the original lying pose and environment, now fully wearing Outfit 3, still breathing and alive with subtle natural expressions. The camera remains unchanged and the fan continues its same steady clockwise rotation.
